english_evidence: Multiple English-language learner reviews describe full lesson programmes taken with this school's instructors (Farlan, Els), e.g. Tainara Scavassin: "I did all my lessons with Els + one with Farlan! ... I'm approved and very happy about it!" and Angel Rondon: "Farlan is a great driving instructor—knowledgeable, patient ... I highly recommend them!"
notes: Category B only (no automaat tag on aggregators; no explicit schakel/automaat statement found, so transmission left unknown). Faalangsttraining and free proefles offered. CBR contact email on file is ikhlasrijschool@home.nl, suggesting link to 'Ikhlas Rijschool'. DISAMBIGUATION/CONFLICTS: (1) rijloket.nl lists website 'correctverkeersschool.nl' and phone '071 402 8056' for this school, but that is a DIFFERENT entity - 'Rijschool Correct' in the Leiden/Katwijk/Zuid-Holland region (since 1990, ~18 instructors); 071 is a Leiden area code, not Den Bosch - so that website/phone are a mis-link and are NOT used. (2) clickdrive.nl's 'Over' text ('Rijschool VLNR, opgericht door William Schalkx') is boilerplate from a different school and lists yet another phone (06 28136805); not reliable for this record. Phone 06 26 93 97 18 is from rijschool-tips.nl listing for rij-correct at Almhof 21. Founding 'Sinds 2009 / 17 jaar' is stated by aggregators (rijloket.nl, rijschool-tips.nl, clickdrive.nl), not the school's own site or KvK, hence med confidence. KvK 69592586 (Eenmanszaak, vestigingsnr 000011693614) and CBR rijschoolnummer 5553G8 confirmed on cbr.nl and vindjerijschool.nl. CBR exam volume modest (~26-46 first exams/4 quarters; ~46% first-time pass).
